subject: Solstice Labs — Activation brief & risks (sales → success passoff)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Alex Burt <alex.burt@solsticelabs.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Solstice Labs — activation brief & risks (sales → success passoff)

Monica / Karthik —

Quick passoff for the Solstice Labs deal we closed yesterday (signed e-sign on Monday). High-level summary and key asks below so CS has what they need to pick this up cleanly. I’ll join the kickoff but want primary steward ownership handed to CS.

Deal highlights:
- Annual committed usage: reserved capacity + hosted API; expected steady ingestion of batch inference for 3 models (~1.2M tokens/month).
- Contracted go-live SLA: 99.9%% availability for dedicated endpoints; 30-day ramp plan in SOW.
- Primary contacts: Alex Burt (VP Product), procurement@solsticelabs.com.

Primary risks / open items:
1) Data residency — they require EU-data fallbacks for certain PII flows (we negotiated scoping but need final routing plan).
2) Identity & SSO — they want Okta SCIM + role mapping before prod.
3) Security questionnaire — procurement asked for completed spreadsheet (attached).
4) Quota strategy — initial traffic spike estimates are conservative; we should propose autoscaling buffer.

Attachments: SOW_Solstice_20260114.pdf (signed), kickoff-agenda-solstice.docx, solstice-security-requests.xlsx

Suggested next steps:
- Monica: nominate primary CS steward and propose internal pre-kick call times this week.
- Karthik: confirm technical owner for Okta integration and EU routing feasibility.
- Aditya: loop legal for a scoped addendum on EU routing if needed.

Alex — forwarding to our CS lead; Monica will reach out to schedule a kickoff.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
[Attachment: SOW_Solstice_20260114.pdf (pdf, 320KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solstice Labs — activation brief & risks (sales → success passoff)

Thanks Neha — quick technical clarifications for CS backlog before kickoff:

- EU data fallback: We can support region-aware routing by next week but it requires a short addendum for reserved capacity in eu-west-1. Estimated additional monthly cost ~15%% of committed capacity.
- Okta SCIM: engineering will own SCIM sync and role claim mapping. Monica, assign an SRE/infra contact for the integration; I’ll provide a short runbook.
- Models & artifacts: They’ll be using two open models + one fine-tuned variant. Please confirm whether they will upload weights to our private model registry or point to external storage.

I pushed a draft runbook and the tentative SRE owner to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSolsticeOnboard (see folder "tech-runbook.md").

[Attachment: solstice-security-requests.xlsx (xls, 45KB)]

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Acknowledged — I’ll take primary stewardship.

Owners and immediate plan:
- CS Lead / Steward: Monica Patel (me) — onboarding, kickoff, acceptance criteria.
- SRE/Technical Lead: Karthik Iyer — Okta SCIM and EU routing feasibility + runbook.
- Legal/Compliance: Aditya Rao to coordinate addendum if EU routing requires reserved capacity changes.

Proposed timeline:
- Internal pre-kick call (CS + SE + PM): Thu 15 Jan, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Customer kickoff: Thu 21 Jan, 10:00–11:00 PT (aim to confirm by EOD Fri)
- Acceptance criteria checklist to be shared by Mon 19 Jan.

Immediate asks to Neha/Alex: please confirm whether Solstice will upload their fine-tuned model artifact to our registry or provide read-only access to their S3 bucket. Also confirm Okta tenant admin to invite for SCIM.

I’ll draft the kickoff agenda and share the CS playbook with internal owners by EOD.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Monica / Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming: Thursday 21 Jan at 10:00 PT for kickoff works for our team (I'll be there).

Answers to immediate asks:
- Model artifacts: We will give Redwood read-only access to a dedicated S3 bucket (details to follow).
- Okta: procurement will provide the Okta tenant admin contact (procurement@solsticelabs.com). We expect SCIM invite to the admin by Monday.
- Security questionnaire: attached filled spreadsheet and a short vendor contact for SOC / security questions.

Thanks,
